KeyTheme: God preserves the Jews in Persia through Esther
Summary: In the Persian capital of Susa, the Jewish queen Esther and her cousin Mordecai expose Haman's plot to destroy the Jews. God providentially preserves His people, and the feast of Purim commemorates the deliverance.
Purpose: To explain the origin of Purim and show God's unseen providence protecting His people in exile.
Outline: Esther becomes queen (1-2); Haman's plot (3-5); Reversal and deliverance (6-10)
HistoricalContext: Set in Susa under King Ahasuerus (Xerxes I, 486-465 BC), when many Jews remained in Persia after the exile.
